acceptance: The agent asks only the use case list first, reads folder, vendor and specification from the use case index, asks a folder only for a name with no row, then asks once for the undeclared facts and never asks for a proposal ID. (B01, B02)

It shows one confirmation table with skip, stops and writes nothing on a duplicate proposal ID, and skips a use case with an existing proposal file unless asked, writing a blank-spec index row for a skipped use case with no row. (B02, B05)

It runs one sequential subagent per use case with the fixed nine-line reply record; a blocked, failed or malformed use case does not stop the batch and appears in the final report, and spec is set after each use case. (B03, B04)

After the loop it runs the recommender once over every index row with a spec after one warned confirmation, runs the exporter once, and hands the review to record-review-decisions in the main conversation. (B06, B07, B08)

Its only own write is an index row, it never writes to the tracker, a proposal file, a specification or a review cell, and with no subagent tool it says so and stops; the review checklist covers B01 to B10 and the file holds no Craft term. (B09, B10)
